---
name: Refactoring
about: Request for code improvement
title: "[Refactor] "
labels: refactor
assignees: ""
---

### Current Issue
> What is the problem? (readability, pipeline structure, duplicated preprocessing/training code, lack of reproducibility, etc.)

### Direction of Improvement
> How will it be changed? (module separation, externalizing configuration values, improving ease of experiment reproduction, etc.)

### Scope of Impact
> List of files/modules/APIs to be changed (fetch / preprocess / models / pipeline / evaluation, etc.).

### Notes
> Whether it needs to be verified that model output (prediction results)/evaluation metrics are the same before and after refactoring, whether test/validation dataset coverage needs to be checked, etc.
